from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyContractLiability(BaseModel):
    """One company's contract liability value from a financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as written in the document")
    contract_liability: float | None = Field(description="The contract liability amount as reported")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the amount, e.g., '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document containing the figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_contract_liabilities: list[CompanyContractLiability]
